verdict.rationale: No native bulk or batch operation is documented: no batch payment, bulk card issuance, or multi-item update endpoint. Bulk work is only reachable indirectly, by scripting the REST API or CLI to loop over list endpoints and per-item actions such as card issuance, invoice creation and transaction updates. A community user did create hundreds of virtual cards, but nothing shows this was done in one operation. Missing for 10: native batch/bulk endpoints (e.g. bulk payments, bulk card creation, bulk categorization), dashboard multi-select actions, MCP bulk tools, and hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
